flashcard_questions.q: In which month and year did Hitler become Chancellor of Germany?
Which book set out the foreign policy aims Hitler pursued from 1933?
Which organisation did Germany leave in October 1933, after the Disarmament Conference?
Which country did Germany sign a non-aggression pact with in January 1934?
Which Austrian Chancellor was murdered during the failed Nazi coup of July 1934?
Which leader moved troops to the Austrian border to stop the 1934 coup?
What was the result of the Saar plebiscite in January 1935?
flashcard_questions.a: 477,000 to 48,000 in favour of rejoining Germany

flashcard_questions.q: How large an army did Hitler announce plans for in March 1935?
What was the German air force, revealed publicly in March 1935, called?
Which front did Britain, France and Italy form in April 1935 to condemn German rearmament?
Which agreement of June 1935 allowed Germany a navy up to 35% of the Royal Navy?
Which historian argued that Hitler was an opportunist rather than a planner?
What did Hillgruber call Hitler's step-by-step programme of expansion?

notes: 13 cards: 5 event to date, 4 agreement or body to name, 2 person, 1 statistic, 1 historian to claim. The four Mein Kampf aims are only named as a group in the content, so they became one book card rather than an invented list.
